displayName: AgentMon Fleet - high or critical agent alert
description: A high or critical alert from the AgentMon monitoring fleet about a Foundry, Copilot Studio or direct-inference caller. One Sentinel alert per fleet alert; incidents are grouped by agent session.
query:
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where Severity in ("high", "critical")
| extend SentinelSeverity = iff(Severity == "critical", "High", "Medium")
| extend CallerIp = tostring(Evidence.caller_ip), CallerObjectId = tostring(Evidence.caller)
| extend OwaspAgenticS = strcat_array(OwaspAgentic, ","), MitreAtlasS = strcat_array(MitreAtlas, ",")
| project TimeGenerated, AlertId, AlertType, Severity, SentinelSeverity, Score, Title, Summary, Platform, AgentName, AgentId, SessionId, UserId, IncidentId, CallerIp, CallerObjectId, OwaspAgenticS, MitreAtlasS

displayName: AgentMon Fleet - agent worked around a block
description: After a policy, guardrail, DLP, approval or 401/403 denial the agent retried the same effect another way (alternate tool, encoding, split steps) or asked the user to do it.
query:
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where AlertType in ("BLOCKED_ACTION_WORKAROUND", "SOCIAL_ENGINEERING_USER", "REPEATED_BLOCKED_ATTEMPTS")
| extend SentinelSeverity = iff(Severity in ("high", "critical"), "High", "Medium")
| extend OwaspAgenticS = strcat_array(OwaspAgentic, ","), MitreAtlasS = strcat_array(MitreAtlas, ",")
| project TimeGenerated, AlertId, AlertType, Severity, SentinelSeverity, Score, Title, Summary, Platform, AgentName, AgentId, SessionId, UserId, IncidentId, OwaspAgenticS, MitreAtlasS

displayName: AgentMon Fleet - possible data exfiltration by an agent
description: An agent sent data to a destination outside its charter allowlist, or a tool call matched exfiltration effects.
query:
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where AlertType in ("DATA_EXFILTRATION", "UNAPPROVED_DESTINATION")
| extend Destination = tostring(coalesce(Evidence.destination, Evidence.dest_host, Evidence.host))
| extend SentinelSeverity = iff(AlertType == "DATA_EXFILTRATION", "High", "Medium")
| extend OwaspAgenticS = strcat_array(OwaspAgentic, ","), MitreAtlasS = strcat_array(MitreAtlas, ",")
| project TimeGenerated, AlertId, AlertType, Severity, SentinelSeverity, Score, Title, Summary, Platform, AgentName, AgentId, SessionId, UserId, IncidentId, Destination, OwaspAgenticS, MitreAtlasS

displayName: AgentMon Fleet - prompt injection followed by a risky action in the same session
description: Indirect prompt injection was suspected in a session and, within 30 minutes, the same session raised a forbidden capability, exfiltration, goal drift or workaround alert (the XPIA kill chain).
query:
let window = 30m;
let injections = AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where AlertType == "PROMPT_INJECTION_SUSPECTED" and isnotempty(SessionId)
| project InjectionTime = TimeGenerated, SessionId, InjectionSummary = Summary;
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where AlertType in ("FORBIDDEN_CAPABILITY", "DATA_EXFILTRATION", "GOAL_DRIFT", "BLOCKED_ACTION_WORKAROUND", "UNAPPROVED_DESTINATION", "CREDENTIAL_ACCESS")
| where isnotempty(SessionId)
| join kind=inner injections on SessionId
| where TimeGenerated between (InjectionTime .. (InjectionTime + window))
| summarize TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated), FollowOn = make_set(AlertType), MaxScore = max(Score), InjectionSummary = take_any(InjectionSummary), AgentName = take_any(AgentName), AgentId = take_any(AgentId), Platform = take_any(Platform), UserId = take_any(UserId), IncidentId = take_any(IncidentId) by SessionId
| extend SentinelSeverity = "High", Title = strcat("Injection then ", strcat_array(FollowOn, ", ")), Summary = InjectionSummary, FollowOnS = strcat_array(FollowOn, ",")
| project TimeGenerated, SessionId, SentinelSeverity, Title, Summary, FollowOnS, MaxScore, AgentName, AgentId, Platform, UserId, IncidentId

displayName: AgentMon Fleet - user probing several agents after refusals
description: The same user raised persistence-after-block or jailbreak alerts on two or more different agents within 24 hours.
query:
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where AlertType in ("USER_PERSISTENCE_AFTER_BLOCK", "JAILBREAK_ATTEMPT", "INTENT_OUT_OF_SCOPE") and isnotempty(UserId)
| summarize TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated), Agents = make_set(coalesce(AgentName, AgentId)), Types = make_set(AlertType), Alerts = count(), Sessions = dcount(SessionId) by UserId
| where array_length(Agents) >= 2 and (set_has_element(Types, "USER_PERSISTENCE_AFTER_BLOCK") or set_has_element(Types, "JAILBREAK_ATTEMPT"))
| extend SentinelSeverity = "Medium", Title = strcat("User probed ", array_length(Agents), " agents"), Summary = strcat(UserId, " raised ", Alerts, " alerts (", strcat_array(Types, ", "), ") across ", strcat_array(Agents, ", ")), AgentsS = strcat_array(Agents, ",")
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, SentinelSeverity, Title, Summary, AgentsS, Alerts, Sessions

displayName: AgentMon Fleet - monitoring disabled or sensitive change on AI resources
description: Diagnostic settings, Log Analytics data or App Insights for AI resources were deleted, or content filters, keys, role assignments or Key Vaults for AI resources changed.
query:
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where AlertType in ("TELEMETRY_TAMPERING", "SENSITIVE_CONTROL_PLANE_OP")
| extend Operation = tostring(Evidence.operation), Caller = tostring(Evidence.caller), CallerIp = tostring(Evidence.caller_ip), ResourceId = tostring(Evidence.resource_id)
| extend SentinelSeverity = iff(AlertType == "TELEMETRY_TAMPERING", "High", "Medium")
| project TimeGenerated, AlertId, AlertType, Severity, SentinelSeverity, Score, Title, Summary, Operation, Caller, CallerIp, ResourceId

displayName: AgentMon Fleet - unregistered model caller also flagged by Defender for AI
description: An identity calling models directly (not a registered agent or allow-listed app) on an AI account that also has a Microsoft Defender for AI (AI.Azure_*) alert in the same 24 hours.
query:
let defender = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(DefenderTime: datetime, Resource: string, DefenderAlert: string, DefenderSeverity: string)[]), (SecurityAlert | where AlertType startswith "AI.Azure_" | extend Resource = tolower(tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1])) | project DefenderTime = TimeGenerated, Resource, DefenderAlert = AlertName, DefenderSeverity = AlertSeverity);
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where AlertType in ("UNREGISTERED_INFERENCE_CALLER", "INFERENCE_ANOMALY", "ACCESS_DENIED_BURST")
| extend Resource = tolower(tostring(Evidence.resource)), Caller = tostring(Evidence.caller)
| join kind=inner defender on Resource
| summarize TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated), FleetTypes = make_set(AlertType), DefenderAlerts = make_set(DefenderAlert), Callers = make_set(Caller) by Resource
| extend SentinelSeverity = "High", Title = strcat("Unregistered model use + Defender alert on ", Resource), Summary = strcat("Fleet: ", strcat_array(FleetTypes, ", "), "; Defender: ", strcat_array(DefenderAlerts, ", "), "; callers: ", strcat_array(Callers, ", ")), CallersS = strcat_array(Callers, ",")
| project TimeGenerated, Resource, SentinelSeverity, Title, Summary, CallersS
